reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not pathologist certification
scope: Gross H&E/spot alignment and deterministic patch spot-checks only
findings: All four overlays place the retained spot grids over the expected tissue regions without an obvious global axis swap or offset.
Barcode-joined patch centers agree numerically with expression coordinates after row/column conversion.
Twelve coordinate-centered thumbnail crops show tissue/background and broad color correspondence with cached patches.
NCBI785 includes only a rectangular assay region within the larger histology field. No claims are made about unmeasured locations outside the available assay region.
Square hidden blocks and circular observed windows retain their specified geometry; exact spot fractions vary when boundary distances tie.
limitations: Low-resolution thumbnails cannot certify cell-level H&E/Xenium registration.
Tissue islands can make a geometric window intersect disconnected tissue; no tissue connectivity claim is made.
A pathologist and study investigator should review cohort suitability before biological interpretation.
